# Atlas CRM

> Atlas CRM is an AI-powered cloud CRM platform built by Liafrik Tech (Dubai – Yaoundé; legal entity Liafrik SPC FZC, Dubai, UAE), unifying sales, customer service, marketing, and AI-driven automation for businesses in Africa, the Middle East, and worldwide.

Atlas CRM combines core CRM functionality (contacts, leads, deals, invoices, tickets, knowledge base) with an integrated AI assistant (Ask Atlas), real workflow automation, and a marketplace of real, working integrations (payments, messaging, e-commerce, support platforms).

## Pricing
Four flat monthly plans per organization, in USD: Starter ($19), Growth ($49), Pro ($119), Enterprise ($219). All plans include a 14-day free trial, no credit card required. Full details: https://atlas.liafrik.com/legal/pricing

## Team and call-center features (Pro and Enterprise)
Customer e-mails and phone numbers can be hidden from agents (enforced by the database) while agents still call, text and e-mail from Atlas; per-agent portfolios; lead distribution (manual, round-robin, file import); team performance and recorded-call listening (Twilio, Aircall, Ringover); live customer events from trading platforms, online stores (e.g. Zanldo) or any webhook; custom fields per industry; a dedicated company.liafrik.com sign-in address. Customer reviews are included from Growth.
